summary.text: Steve Manos is a Republican, business owner and mayor of Lake Elsinore, California, running for California's 39th Congressional District. According to his campaign website, he has lived in the Inland Empire since 1987, has owned a business since 1996 and was first elected to the Lake Elsinore City Council in 2012. His campaign theme is 'Faith, Family, and Affordability.'

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, Steve Manos grew up in the Inland Empire and has lived there since 1987; he has been married since 1999 and is the father of four children.
He has been a business owner since 1996 and is a past president of the Inland Valleys Association of Realtors.
Manos was a Sector Commander for the Lake Elsinore Citizens Emergency Response Team and received the 2015 Lake Elsinore Chamber of Commerce Citizen of the Year award.
Manos was elected to the Lake Elsinore City Council in 2012 and has served as mayor of Lake Elsinore in 2015, 2019, 2024 and 2026.

He is a director of the Riverside County Habitat Conservation Authority and the Southern California Association of Governments, a director of the League of California Cities and president of its Riverside County Division, and chair of the Southwest Riverside Energy Authority; he is a former director of the Riverside Transit Authority.
He ran in the March 3, 2020 nonpartisan primary for California State Assembly District 67, placing fourth of five candidates with 14.2% of the vote and not advancing to the general election.
Manos advanced from the June 2, 2026 nonpartisan primary with 39.0% of the vote (48,177 votes) to a general election against incumbent Mark Takano.
